items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1959-11-17
items.q: And he used to go with us on the scurgeon sometimes. Rabbit would talk from the all the way to Baton Rouge without stopping.

ctx.x: Ask him what he'd teach. Ask him what he teach. Do you know Rabbit from James Alley? Who?

Rabbit. Do you know Rabbit from James Alley? Rabbit? It was Rabbit, he used to play Gitto and sing. And he wouldn't, you know, he just was by himself. And he used to go with us on the scurgeon sometimes. Rabbit would talk from the all the way to Baton Rouge without stopping. And he'd come back that night, he couldn't talk at all, he'd be the host.
Ask him what he featured, what did he feature? What did he teach? What did he feature, what kind of numbers?
